name: The Lantern Barge
legend: # = wall, . = floor, P = player start, D = door slot (in the outer wall), C = chest, S = rest shrine

challenge.text: Finish in 90 seconds for a better chest!
challenge.outOfTimeText: Wide river! You still earned a chest.

waves_note: Enemies arrive in waves: the next wave comes when 1 enemy (or none) is left.
mix: L11 swap: every Rolling Pins -> Boppers.
artProps: Layout copied from supper-rush. Theme and props from the quiet-river draft room "lantern-barge". A wide barge with a row of unlit lanterns; two lantern posts in each corner.
signs: Many oars make the river easy.
